annotations.title: Undo your changes to a clip

description: Use this when the person wants to take back changes you (the person's AI) made to a clip with the edit tools, newest first, the same as Undo in the Slice editor. With no edit_id or count it undoes the newest change; count undoes the newest n (up to 10); edit_id undoes back to and including that change. list true only lists the recent changes with their ids. Saves the clip only, no render.

clip_id.description: The clip's id (from get_episode, get_job or the Slice link).

name: undo_edit

open_in_slice.description: The clip in the Slice editor, where the person sees the change.
